description: A fictional heavy heat-lance game prop for a cave warden, chunky low-poly, carried level at the hip with the lance mouth forward. The front half is one long thick dark steel lance, its rear half covered by an angular dark steel shroud box with big chamfers and three wide raised blocks along its top, ending at the tip in one flared square dark steel mouth with a thick chamfered rim and a dark throat that closes a short way in. Under the lance one fat dark steel pilot tube held by one chunky clamp, ending just behind the mouth in one chunky igniter block with a short fat stub. Behind the lance one angular slate blue-grey painted body block with wide chamfers, one small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on its left flank. Lying lengthwise on top of the body one fat octagonal slate blue-grey cylinder with flat chamfered ends, in a dark steel saddle, with two wide charcoal clamp bands, a thick angular charcoal carry handle standing on the two bands, and one large round dark steel gauge with a thick bezel and one chunky needle on its rear end. One fat segmented charcoal hose coils from the rear end of the cylinder down into the rear of the body. Under the front of the body one fat charcoal vertical front grip with thick ribbed segments; at the rear one chunky charcoal pistol grip with big diagonal ribs and a squared trigger guard. No stock.
proportions: About 0.95 m long, 0.16 m wide and 0.42 m tall. (length : width : height = 5.94 : 1 : 2.63)
sides: on the LEFT flank only: the teal lamp window on the body and the round gauge face at the rear end of the cylinder (its bezel stands a little proud of the cylinder on the left). The right flank is plain slate body and cylinder. The lance, the mouth, the pilot tube under the lance, the cylinder, its bands and carry handle, the hose behind, the front grip and the pistol grip are on the centre line.
